Candle 0.11.0 — Hugging Face. MIT OR Apache-2.0. Previously supplied source archives are historical; this release retains component licenses and change notices.
Candle-core: skip unused weight gradients and guard empty views/gradient additions.
Candle-kernels: local CUDA f32/u32 index_add atomic scatter change (CUDA is not part of browser runtime).
Upstream https://github.com/huggingface/candle

Current browser response runtime adds coordinate-gradient/autodiff support; CUDA is not included. No upstream endorsement is implied.
